regulations.occupancy_limits: Only one booking at a time per property
regulations.notes: Aurora allows STRs in residential areas as a 'home occupation,' which means only the resident of the home can operate the rental — you cannot rent short-term if the property is not your primary residence. A business license is required (for rentals under 30 days). Only one group of guests can book at a time. HOA rules may also prohibit STRs.
